paite: Ni nuai a ka muh gilou a-om a, mite tung ah agik hi.
heading: Hauhsakna Leh Haksatna

paite: Mi Pathian in hauhsakna leh neih zohna leh zahna apiak a, huchi a adeih peuh akha a dia bangmah taksap nei het lou a, himahleh huai ne ding a Pathian in thilhihtheihna apiak louh a, mikhual in anek zawkna; hiai bangmah lou ahi a, gilou natna ahi.
Mihing in ta zakhat suang henla, kum tampi dam in akumte nite tampi phaleh, akha lah hoih in dim kei ngal in, kivuina nei kei ngalleh; amah a ding in ahun lou a pian ahoihzaw ka chi ahi.
Bangmah lou lah ahong hi a, khomial ah apaimang a, khomial in amin akhuh hi.
Huai lou in ni amu kei a, theih leng athei kei; hiai in adang sang in akhawlna anei hi.
Ahi, kum sangkhat gentuan dam mahleh, hoih nuam asakpih tuan kei; bang teng mun khat ah apai kei uh maw?
Mihing sepgimna tengteng akam a ding ahi a, himahleh agilkialna adim tuan kei.
Mihai sang in mipil in bang phattuamna anei a le? Ahihkeileh, mihing ma a omdan thei, migenthei in bang anei a?
Lunggulhna tam vak sang in mitte muh ahoihzaw hi; hiai leng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh lel ahi.
Ana om khinsa bangpeuh, sawtpi a huai amin piaksa ahi, huan mihing ahi chih theih ahi; amah sang a hatzaw amah toh leng akisual thei kei ding hi.
Thil tampi bangmah lou pungsak a om ding chih thei in, mihing bang ahoih tuan a?
Adamsung bangmah lou limliap bang a asukbei tengteng, adamsung in mihing a ding a hoih kua'n athei a le? Ni nuai ah amah nung in bang a-om dia chih kua'n mihing ahilh thei a ahia?
